Page 713 
GLP-1 Agonists - AZM 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-715192  
Guideline Name 
GLP-1 Agonists - AZM  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred Drugs: Mounjaro, Trulicity, Brand Victoza, generic liraglutide  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Both of the following:  
 
 1.1 Submission of medical records (e.g. chart notes) confirming both of the following:  
• 
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
• 
Baseline A1C greater than or equal to 6.5%  


=== PDF PAGE 714 ===
Page 714 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams (mg) daily for 90 days, or 
contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 10 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Drug is not being used for weight loss  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a DPP-4 
inhibitor-containing agent [e.g., Januvia (sitagliptin), Jentadueto (linagliptin-metformin), 
Tradjenta (linagliptin)] or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
Notes  
If requested medication is being used to treat appetite suppression/we
ight loss or improve conditions caused by obesity (i.e., Zepbound for 
OSA) – deny the case for Plan Exclusion. For all other indications den
y the case for medical necessity and do not review for off-label use. 
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred Drugs: Ozempic injection, Exenatide  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Both of the following:  
 
 1.1 Submission of medical records (e.g. chart notes) confirming both of the following:  
• 
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  


=== PDF PAGE 715 ===
Page 715 
• 
Baseline A1C greater than or equal to 6.5%  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams (mg) daily for 90 days, or 
contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting a history of 
a 90 day trial resulting in a therapeutic failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the 
following:  
• 
Trulicity  
• 
Brand Victoza or generic liraglutide  
• 
Mounjaro  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
4 - Drug is not being used for weight loss  
 
AND 
 
5 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a DPP-4 
inhibitor-containing agent [e.g., Januvia (sitagliptin), Jentadueto (linagliptin-metformin), 
Tradjenta (linagliptin)] or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
Notes  
If requested medication is being used to treat appetite suppression/we
ight loss or improve conditions caused by obesity (i.e., Zepbound for 
OSA) – deny the case for Plan Exclusion. For all other indications den
y the case for medical necessity and do not review for off-label use. 
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Ozempic tablets, Rybelsus  


=== PDF PAGE 716 ===
Page 716 
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Both of the following:  
 
 1.1 Submission of medical records (e.g. chart notes) confirming both of the following:  
• 
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
• 
Baseline A1C greater than or equal to 6.5%  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams (mg) daily for 90 days, or 
contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting a history of 
a 90 day trial resulting in a therapeutic failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the 
following:  
• 
Trulicity  
• 
Brand Victoza or generic liraglutide  
• 
Mounjaro  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 BOTH of the following:  
 
  2.2.1 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming that the patient is unable 
to self-inject due to ONE of the following:  
• 
Physical impairment  
• 
Visual impairment  
• 
Lipohypertrophy  


=== PDF PAGE 717 ===
Page 717 
• 
Documented needle-phobia to the degree that the patient has previously refused any 
injectable therapy or medical procedure (refer to DSM-5 for specific phobia diagnostic 
criteria)  
 
AND 
 
  2.2.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting a history 
of a 90 day trial resulting in a therapeutic failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the 
following:  
• 
Farxiga  
• 
Jardiance  
• 
Synjardy  
• 
Xigduo XR  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
4 - Drug is not being used for weight loss  
 
AND 
 
5 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a DPP-4 
inhibitor-containing agent [e.g., Januvia (sitagliptin), Jentadueto (linagliptin-metformin), 
Tradjenta (linagliptin)] or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
Notes  
If requested medication is being used to treat appetite suppression/we
ight loss or improve conditions caused by obesity (i.e., Zepbound for 
OSA) – deny the case for Plan Exclusion. For all other indications den
y the case for medical necessity and do not review for off-label use.
